title: Namespaces and resource quotas per team

videos.script: Lesson 7 said a namespace only changes where a name is looked up. That is true, and it is also the starting point for sharing a cluster. {{start}} Two objects turn a namespace into a team's allowance. A ResourceQuota caps the total the namespace may ask for: pods, CPU, memory. A LimitRange sets what each container gets when its author forgot to say, and how much any one container may ask for. {{two}} You will give team A a budget, deploy into it without writing a single request, and watch the defaults appear. {{defaults}} Then you will scale past the budget, and see where the refusal turns up. It is not where most people look. {{refusal}}
